Package org.opencastproject.assetmanager.util

Class AssetStoreDirectory

java.lang.Object
org.opencastproject.assetmanager.util.AssetStoreDirectory
public final class AssetStoreDirectory extends Object
A root directory of the file system based asset store together with the directory layout used inside it.

Within a root directory, assets are stored as <root>/<organization>/[<prefix>/]<mediapackage>/<version>/<element>. The optional prefix directory is derived from the first characters of the media package identifier (see prefix(String, int)) and keeps the number of entries in the organization directory small. A prefix length of zero means no prefix directory, which is the default.

This class is the single place where asset manager directories are read from the configuration and where paths inside them are built, so that the asset store and the workspace agree on the layout.

    • prefix

      public static String prefix(String mpId, int length)
      Derive the prefix directory name from a media package identifier.

      Of the first length characters of the identifier, ASCII upper case letters are converted to lower case, and every character which is not an ASCII letter or digit is replaced by an underscore. Identifiers shorter than the prefix length are padded with underscores. This guarantees that the result is a safe directory name of exactly length characters. The rule deliberately avoids the JDK's Unicode tables, since it must never change: existing data depends on it.

      Parameters:
      mpId - the media package identifier
      length - the prefix length
      Returns:
      the prefix, or an empty string if length is zero

    • deletionLimit

      public Path deletionLimit(String orgId, String mpId)
      The directory up to which empty parent directories of a media package may be removed when deleting assets. This is the prefix directory if prefixes are used and the organization directory otherwise. Prefix directories are never removed since unrelated media packages may be written to them concurrently.
      Parameters:
      orgId - the organization identifier
      mpId - the media package identifier
      Returns:
      the directory which must not be removed

    • fromConfig

      public static List<AssetStoreDirectory> fromConfig(org.osgi.framework.BundleContext bundleContext)
      Read the asset manager directories from the configuration.

      The base directory is configured by CONFIG_ROOT_DIR and defaults to archive below CONFIG_STORAGE_DIR. Additional directories are configured by "org.opencastproject.episode.rootdir".N with N starting at one and incrementing without gaps. The prefix length of a directory is configured by appending ".prefix.length" to its key.

      Parameters:
      bundleContext - the bundle context providing the configuration
      Returns:
      the configured directories with the base directory first, or null if no storage directory is configured
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a prefix length is not a non-negative integer

    • verifyOrWriteMarker

      public void verifyOrWriteMarker() throws ConfigurationException, IOException
      Make sure the layout recorded in the directory's marker file matches this configuration, writing the marker file if the directory does not have one yet.

      A directory without marker file is considered to hold data in the flat layout if it contains any subdirectory other than lost+found or hidden directories. Such a directory can only be used with a prefix length of zero. The marker file is written to a temporary file first and then linked into place, so that it appears atomically with its full content and several nodes sharing the directory may start at the same time.

      Throws:
      ConfigurationException - if the marker file does not match the configured prefix length
      IOException - if the marker file cannot be read or written
